content: अभिसारः .²1 Going to meet (as a lovers), appointment, assignation; रतिसुखसारे गतमभिसारे मदनमनोहरवेशम् <ls>Gīt. 5</ls>. .²2 The place where lovers meet by appointment, rendezvous; त्वरितमुपैति न कथमभिसारम् <ls>Gīt. 6</ls>. .²3 An attack, assault; श्वोऽभिसारः पुरस्य नः <ls>Rām.</ls> .²4 War, battle. .²5 A follower, companion. .²6 Might, power. .²7 An instrument, means; अभिसारेण सर्वेण तत्र युद्धमवर्तत <ls>Mb. 3. 15. 4</ls>. .²8 A purificatory rite. .²9 ({@˚राः@} <ab>pl.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of a people. .{@-री@} <ab>N.</ab> of a town.
